questions.q: Which ancient city carved into pink rock was the Nabataean capital?
questions.why: It is one of the New 7 Wonders of the World.

questions.q: In which year did Jordan become independent from Britain?
questions.why: Independence Day is 25 May.

questions.q: Who has been King of Jordan since 1999?
questions.why: His wife is Queen Rania.

questions.q: Which king ruled Jordan for 46 years until 1999?
questions.why: He made peace with Israel in 1994.

questions.q: Which family has ruled Jordan since its founding?
questions.why: They trace descent from the Prophet Muhammad.

questions.q: Which film was shot in Wadi Rum and Petra in 1962?
questions.why: T. E. Lawrence fought in the region.

questions.q: Which river runs along Jordan's western border?
questions.why: Jesus is said to have been baptised there.

questions.q: Which king founded the Emirate of Transjordan in 1921?
questions.why: He became king in 1946.

questions.q: Which Roman city in the north is called the 'Pompeii of the East'?
questions.why: Its colonnaded streets are well preserved.

questions.q: Which 1994 agreement did King Hussein sign?
questions.why: It was signed in the Arava Valley.

questions.q: Which Swiss explorer rediscovered Petra for Europe in 1812?
questions.why: He travelled in disguise.

questions.q: Which town is famous for a 6th-century mosaic map of the Holy Land?
questions.why: It is in St George's Church.

questions.q: Which 1916 revolt against the Ottomans began in the Hejaz?
questions.why: Sharif Hussein of Mecca launched it.

questions.q: Which crusader castle on a hilltop dominates a southern town?
questions.why: It was besieged by Saladin.

questions.q: Which site on the Jordan River is the UNESCO-listed baptism site?
questions.why: It is called Al-Maghtas.

questions.q: What is the capital of Jordan?
questions.why: It was once called Philadelphia.

questions.q: Which salt lake on Jordan's border is the lowest point on land?
questions.why: Its water is very salty.

questions.q: Which desert valley is called the 'Valley of the Moon'?
questions.why: Many sci-fi films were shot there.

questions.q: Which port city is Jordan's only outlet to the sea?
questions.why: It is on the Red Sea.

questions.q: What is Jordan's currency?
questions.why: It is one of the world's highest-valued currencies.

questions.q: Which lamb and rice dish with dried yoghurt sauce is the national dish?
questions.why: It is eaten with the right hand.

questions.q: What is the famous building at the end of Petra's narrow gorge called?
questions.why: It appears in 'Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade'.

questions.q: What is the narrow gorge leading into Petra called?
questions.why: It is about 1.2 km long.

questions.q: Which queen of Jordan is known for education campaigns?
questions.why: She was born in Kuwait.

questions.q: Which upside-down rice dish is a family favourite?
questions.why: Its name means 'upside down'.

questions.q: Which nature reserve has canyons for river hikes?
questions.why: It is near the Dead Sea.

questions.q: Which Bedouin red-and-white headscarf is a Jordanian symbol?
questions.why: The red-and-white pattern is typical of Jordan.

questions.q: Which large oasis in the eastern desert has a wetland reserve?
questions.why: T. E. Lawrence stayed at its castle.

questions.q: Which Petra building, reached by 800 steps, is larger than the Treasury?
questions.why: It sits high on a mountain.

questions.q: What does the name 'Petra' mean?
questions.why: The Nabataeans called it Raqmu.
